fields.description: Grove Ridge is an Emaar South development with one to three bedroom apartments and a small collection of three bedroom townhouses. Two apartment towers share the golf-course neighbourhood, while the townhouses provide living space across two levels. The plans include both compact balconies and larger terraces, so homes with the same bedroom count can feel quite different.

overview: The brochure’s emphasis is on an open-plan home within a green neighbourhood, with pools, play areas and indoor and outdoor exercise spaces. An 18-hole golf course is part of the surrounding community. A fairway-facing lifestyle does not establish a particular apartment view or include a golf membership; those details need a unit-level check.
research.locationNote: The brochure places Grove Ridge in Emaar South, within Dubai South and near Al Maktoum International Airport. Emirates Road and the DWC peripheral road are shown in the location material. Confirm the practical route to work, school and everyday shopping from the selected building.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently shows units from AED 2,626,888. Its earlier AED 1.2 million headline and the copied launch fact sheet’s AED 1.27 million entry price describe different references. Neither establishes an available home today; request a dated quotation for the selected unit.
research.paymentNote: The Emaar-branded launch schedule below is hosted by a broker and totals 80% before completion, then 20% at completion. Property Finder corroborates the overall split. Several launch instalments are already in the past; the schedule is historical and must be replaced by current written terms for a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: The copied payment sheet targets September 2029 for estimated construction completion, consistent with Property Finder’s Q3 2029 reference. Confirm the current contractual target and any revised schedule directly before purchase.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: The broker-hosted Emaar-branded fact sheet describes 193 homes: 64 one bedroom, 106 two bedroom and 18 three bedroom apartments, plus five townhouses. This is a launch mix, not available inventory.

facts.label: Building layout
facts.value: Official plans distinguish two apartment towers from a G + P townhouse wing. Tower 1’s floor-count annotations differ within the massing graphic; confirm the precise floor numbering for any reservation.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: The published totals combine suite and balcony areas. Larger terrace layouts can substantially increase the total without a matching increase in indoor space.
